title: Monthly Revenue Trend
template:
Show the monthly revenue trend for the last {months} months. Include month-over-month growth percentages and highlight any significant changes.

Provide a structured analysis:
1. DATA TABLE: Present the data in a markdown table with columns: Month, Revenue, MoM Growth %, Trend
2. TREND ANALYSIS: Describe overall direction, seasonality patterns, and growth/decline periods
3. KEY INSIGHTS: List 3-5 bullet points highlighting notable findings
4. RECOMMENDATIONS: Suggest 2-3 actionable items based on the trends

title: Revenue by Product Category
template:
Show revenue breakdown by product category for {quarter} {year}. Include percentages and compare with the previous quarter.

Provide a structured analysis:
1. DATA TABLE: Category, Revenue, % Share, QoQ Change
2. ANALYSIS: Which categories are growing/declining and why
3. KEY INSIGHTS: Top 3-5 findings about category performance
4. RECOMMENDATIONS: Focus areas and potential opportunities

title: Top Revenue Generating Accounts
template:
List the top {count} revenue-generating accounts. Show their total revenue, product mix, and growth trend for the last {months} months.

Provide a structured analysis:
1. DATA TABLE: Rank, Account, Total Revenue, Primary Products, Growth Rate
2. CONCENTRATION ANALYSIS: Revenue concentration risk (top 5, top 10 share)
3. KEY INSIGHTS: Account-level patterns and risks
4. RECOMMENDATIONS: Retention strategies for top accounts

title: Revenue Leakage Detection
template:
Analyze billing data for potential revenue leakage. Check for unbilled CDRs, rating mismatches, and service-charge discrepancies over the last {days} days.

Provide a structured analysis:
1. DATA TABLE: Leakage Type, Affected Records, Estimated Revenue Impact
2. ROOT CAUSE: Identify patterns or systemic issues causing each leakage type
3. KEY INSIGHTS: Severity ranking and business impact
4. RECOMMENDATIONS: Remediation steps prioritized by financial impact

title: Customer Distribution by Region
template:
Show customer distribution by region. Include total counts, percentage share, and growth rate for each region.

Provide a structured analysis:
1. DATA TABLE: Region, Customer Count, % Share, YoY Growth
2. GEOGRAPHIC ANALYSIS: Distribution patterns and regional strengths
3. KEY INSIGHTS: Underserved regions with growth potential
4. RECOMMENDATIONS: Market expansion priorities

title: Customer Churn Analysis
template:
Analyze customer churn over the last {months} months. Show churn rate trend, top {count} reasons for churn, and identify currently at-risk accounts.

Provide a structured analysis:
1. DATA TABLE: Month, Churned Customers, Churn Rate %, Revenue Lost
2. CHURN REASON ANALYSIS: Top reasons ranked by frequency and revenue impact
3. AT-RISK LIST: Currently at-risk accounts with risk indicators
4. RECOMMENDATIONS: Targeted retention strategies per churn reason

title: New Customer Acquisition Trend
template:
Show new customer acquisitions over the last {months} months. Break down by acquisition channel and compare with targets.

Provide a structured analysis:
1. DATA TABLE: Month, New Customers, Channel Breakdown, vs Target %
2. CHANNEL ANALYSIS: Cost per acquisition and conversion rates by channel
3. KEY INSIGHTS: Most effective channels and seasonal patterns
4. RECOMMENDATIONS: Budget allocation adjustments

title: Customer Segmentation Analysis
template:
Perform customer segmentation based on ARPU, tenure, and product usage. Identify the top {count} segments with their characteristics.

Provide a structured analysis:
1. DATA TABLE: Segment, Size, Avg ARPU, Avg Tenure, Primary Products, Growth Trend
2. SEGMENT PROFILES: Detailed characteristics and behavior patterns per segment
3. KEY INSIGHTS: Highest-value segments and underserved opportunities
4. RECOMMENDATIONS: Targeted strategies per segment

title: Overdue Payment Analysis
template:
Show overdue payment analysis. Include aging buckets (30/60/90/120+ days), total overdue amount, and top {count} overdue accounts.

Provide a structured analysis:
1. DATA TABLE: Aging Bucket, Count, Total Amount, % of Total
2. ACCOUNT LIST: Top overdue accounts with amount, days overdue, contact history
3. KEY INSIGHTS: Trends in overdue patterns and collection effectiveness
4. RECOMMENDATIONS: Priority collection actions and process improvements

title: Payment Method Distribution
template:
Show payment method distribution for the last {months} months. Include volume, value, success rate, and failure reasons per method.

Provide a structured analysis:
1. DATA TABLE: Method, Volume, Total Value, Success Rate %, Top Failure Reason
2. TREND ANALYSIS: Shifts in payment method preference over time
3. KEY INSIGHTS: Methods with low success rates requiring attention
4. RECOMMENDATIONS: Steps to improve success rates and encourage preferred methods

title: Failed Payment Root Cause
template:
Analyze failed payments over the last {days} days. Group by failure reason, identify trends, and flag any systemic issues.

Provide a structured analysis:
1. DATA TABLE: Failure Reason, Count, Total Value, Trend (Up/Down/Stable)
2. PATTERN ANALYSIS: Time-based patterns (day/hour), customer segments affected
3. KEY INSIGHTS: Systemic issues vs. one-off failures
4. RECOMMENDATIONS: Technical fixes and process changes to reduce failures

title: Payment Reconciliation Report
template:
Run payment reconciliation for the last {days} days. Identify unmatched payments, overpayments, underpayments, and unapplied credits.

Provide a structured analysis:
1. DATA TABLE: Category (Unmatched/Over/Under/Unapplied), Count, Total Amount
2. DETAIL LIST: Top mismatches with payment and invoice references
3. KEY INSIGHTS: Common mismatch patterns and root causes
4. RECOMMENDATIONS: Process improvements and system configuration changes

title: Bill Cycle Status
template:
Show the status of billing cycles for the last {count} cycles. Include success rate, error counts, processing time, and any stuck jobs.

Provide a structured analysis:
1. DATA TABLE: Cycle, Start/End Time, Records Processed, Success Rate, Errors, Duration
2. TREND ANALYSIS: Processing time and error rate trends across cycles
3. KEY INSIGHTS: Recurring issues and performance bottlenecks
4. RECOMMENDATIONS: Optimizations for faster and more reliable bill runs

title: Service Provisioning Queue
template:
Show the current service provisioning queue status. Include pending, in-progress, completed, and failed counts for the last {hours} hours.

Provide a structured analysis:
1. DATA TABLE: Status (Pending/In-Progress/Completed/Failed), Count, Avg Age, Oldest Order
2. FAILURE ANALYSIS: Top reasons for failed provisioning orders
3. KEY INSIGHTS: Queue health and throughput capacity
4. RECOMMENDATIONS: Bottleneck resolution and capacity planning

title: Rating Engine Performance
template:
Show rating engine performance metrics for the last {days} days. Include throughput (events/sec), average latency, error rate, and peak loads.

Provide a structured analysis:
1. DATA TABLE: Date, Avg Throughput, Peak Throughput, Avg Latency, Error Rate %
2. PATTERN ANALYSIS: Peak usage patterns, latency spikes, error correlation
3. KEY INSIGHTS: Capacity utilization and performance trends
4. RECOMMENDATIONS: Scaling recommendations and performance tuning
